## Review of the last part

- High, packages/database/src/queries/list-left-teams-of-season.ts:5: the new query has no isolation case, so `isolation-coverage.test.ts` ("every exported function has an isolation case") FAILS now (run by the reviewer); `npm run verify` is red. Fix: register a case for listLeftTeamsOfSeason in packages/database/src/isolation/teams-cases.test-helper.ts.
- Medium, packages/core/src/modules/standings/level-groups.ts:25 and commands/list-adjustments.ts:67: the screen matches a flip to a level set only when the teams are exactly the same, but packages/sports (order-teams.ts:170) applies the latest flip that CONTAINS the set. A flip for A, B, C, after C pulls clear, still orders A and B in public ("A coin flip puts A ahead of B") while Admin shows A and B as level with no flip and the old flip as "unused"; taking that "unused" flip off changes the public table. Fix: use the same "covers" rule in flipFor (or make sports exact), and a test where a tie shrinks and where a third team joins.
- Medium, packages/core/src/modules/scheduling/commands/add-draft-game.ts:70: only adding a draft game refuses a team that has left. A draft game added before the mark is published by publish_schedule with no check, put_back_draft_game brings one back, and apply-fixture-import accepts games for it (builder 4 said so). Fix: refuse `team-left` for draft games that are new to the published schedule at publish (and preview), and in the fixture import's plan, with tests.
- Medium, packages/core/src/modules/games/decide-game.ts:70 and games-page.tsx:241: a forfeit after line-ups trusts the server's status, but a tracker that started the game offline still reads "scheduled" here; the forfeit then makes the device's plays refused on sync, and the page says "the game has not started" as a fact. Fix: refuse (or warn in the confirm) while a scoring session for the game is open or its device was seen recently, and word the sentence as "nothing has reached us from the tracker".
- Low, packages/core/src/modules/standings/rebuild-season.ts (withCoinFlipLast): when a season lists the coin flip before other tiebreakers, sports tries the flip on the wider group at that step, so a flip recorded for the final level set never applies while the screen shows it recorded. Fix: accept flips only when coin-flip is last, or work level sets out at the coin-flip step.
- Low, packages/core/src/modules/standings/commands/record-coin-flip.ts:46: no version; two admins recording at once, the later bins the earlier's order with no "changed since". "drawn" is the web action's claim (core accepts any order labelled drawn). Fix: carry the shown flip's id as the version; draw in core through a random port.
- Low, packages/core/src/modules/games/commands/list-later-games.ts:49: reads every game of a year with no limit, twice per Games page load; games past 366 days are on no list while the note says "every game still to come"; games-page.tsx:765 "Only the first 100 are shown" does not say to choose a team. Fix: cut in the query, word both notes truly.
- Low, tests/browser/coin-flip-test.mjs:103,128,157 and later-games-test.mjs:158,207,237: whole-page finders (getByText(name).first(), the "Later games" link by name .first() though `data-to-later` exists, main text includes "Left the league."). Fix: find by the `data-…` marks.
- Low, apps/web/src/features/teams-area/teams-page.tsx: the admin Teams list shows no "left" mark (builder 4 said so); no lock between mark_team_left and add_draft_game. Fix: the mark in the list; lock the team row in both.
- Checked and sound: 0025's league id, RLS equal to standings_adjustments, season FK with league, insert trigger and fixed list, no DELETE, league_rows (league-removal and RLS tests pass); locks (lockSeason before the level check, same lock as a rebuild); live forfeit still refused (test); Later games scope per game and the 100 limit tested; mark/undo version and teams.manage; no change to packages/sports or apps/live-stats; no SQL or text outside their places. Reviewer ran: record-coin-flip, record-forfeit, schedule-draft-commands (28), isolation harness, two-leagues, coverage+registry (1 failed), role-matrix, teams-commands, conventions (266), league-removal, RLS (32).
